We evaluate its performance across four distinct text generation tasks on a subset of languages outlined in: Cross-Lingual Question Answering (XorQA-In), Multilingual Question-Answering (XQuAD-In), Machine Translation (Flores-In), and Cross-Lingual Summarization (CrossSum-In)...
In this work, we focus on downstream generation tasks with low-resource Indic languages, a critical challenge for making LLMs more widely accessible.

We report Token-F1 results for performance on Bodo, Manipuri and Maithili... For translation and summarization tasks, we report chrF1 results.

Following prior work , we report the Character-F1 (chrF1) metric  for cross-lingual summarization and translation tasks, as token-level metrics like ROUGE and BLEU are considered unreliable for low-resource languages . For QA tasks (XQuAD-IN and XorQA-IN), we use the Token-F1 metric to maintain consistency with the existing literature .
